minimum_generalized_authoring_decisions: Keep a separate pinned input/output row per character. Existing accepted neutral sources are identity/gait baselines; if new high-detail models arrive, use their own matching source clips/binds and new source hashes, never assume old neutral clips share the new bind.

Use each actual source/returned geometry correspondence to measure scale, triangle count, UV correspondence and corner-normal preservation. Do not copy the pilot103544-triangle or1.82000084619 scale constants. These baseline sources have unique1e-6 UV triangle keys but do not establish future returned topology.

Reuse the22-major-bone component-delta mapping only after matching each own source reference. Derive shoulder, forward, elbow and finger axes from each new target; author relaxed finger/idle motion there, not by copying pilot quaternions.

All seven retained jumps expose backward elbows on both sides; keep them frozen and author fresh corrected own-rig jump derivatives. Their idle seam and some jump scale/reference drift are baseline limitations, not new-target passes.

Retain own gait timing/hip motion, canonical Armature object and unexported neutral reference. Set fps30/fps_base1 after every import and verify actual FBX time mode, duration and curve KTime with the established one-tick precision bound.

Import only each new Resident3-8/10 private folder. Replace the whole-parent absence guard with per-resident absence, never delete or overwrite the preserved Resident9 pilot. Body plus all four clips must use the same measured import scale.

Select the intended per-style prop, especially style8PVCTube. Calibrate using actual native prop bounds and own hand/palm, retain hand-relative following and explicitly restore production RightHand/absolute rotation when flags are removed.

Generalize complete four-flag routing to all intended styles while keeping default/incomplete-flag routes and installed packages unchanged. Strip pilot flags explicitly in legacy24-bone fixtures; require mandatory own-rig/finger/graph/prop/crew-cycle checks for every new style before adoption.
readiness_limits: This artifact inventories existing accepted neutral sources only; no new provider output, new high-detail model or new-target scale/UV/weights is accepted.
Both elbows bend backward in every retained Jump; existing idle loops have a small seam and WhiteCap/RedJersey Jump reference-scale comparisons exceed1e-5. No acceptance gate was waived.
No edited source scripts, native code, models, images, saved assets, packages, saves, settings or services. Only new ignored inventory copies and the two declared readiness documents were written.
No render, native motion/clearance/grasp, package/performance, browser/device or off-LAN result follows.
